metadata.short_desc: Auto-proxy plugin for ModelScope free LLMs
metadata.desc: Manually configure model_list, expose an OpenAI-compatible API with automatic failover and smart rate limiting.

proxy_host.hint: Keep 127.0.0.1 for local-only access; use 0.0.0.0 to allow external access

proxy_api_key.hint: Leave empty to disable authentication; set to prevent unauthorized access

global_quota_reserve.hint: e.g. set to 10, the plugin stops making requests when remaining quota ≤ 10, preserving at least 10 requests for other features

virtual_models.description: Virtual model config list. Each virtual model has its own fallback list and optional fallback provider.

default.name: Virtual Model Config
default.hint: Configure an exposed model name and its fallback list

timeout.hint: Set a longer value, e.g. 120, for slow model generation

fallback.description: Fallback model provider (optional, when all ModelScope models are unavailable)
fallback.hint: Select a configured provider as fallback; leave empty for none

monitor.title: Quota Monitor
monitor.description: View real-time remaining quota and status of each ModelScope model
monitor.no_models: No models configured in this virtual model
